routes.reason: The maintainer routed this paper to the RankOneConverse Part II of RankZeroOneBSD (papers.json guide DESIGN-SKINNER): the parent proves the Gross–Zagier–Kolyvagin direction and has no layer for the converse, and PAPER-CASTELLA-ETAL-22 already extends the same Part II. The brief states Theorems A, A′, B, C and E correctly; the review added to it the gap in Lemma 2.2.2, which bears on Theorems A and E when [M_f:Q] > 1, added six missing items to it and removed item 21, which SelmerIwasawaCohomology L2 plans.
SelmerIwasawaCohomology L4 plans the arithmetic Selmer conditions and conjectures but no parity theorem; Nekovář's parity theorem for ordinary modular forms belongs there.

R19.1 and R19.3 own the weight-two representations and their compatible system; the density-one ordinary primes, large-p irreducibility and ramification at every prime dividing N are statements about that system. The review added Serre's density-zero theorem for a_p(f) = 0, the input to the first.
GZ.9 constructs the BDP/Brooks p-adic L-function; its integrality (membership in O^ur[[Γ]]) and the dictionary with the imprimitive L^S_𝔭(f) are the two facts Skinner needs beyond what GZ.9 states.
Added by the review: the rank-zero converse (item 3) is a consequence of the ordinary main conjecture that ModularIwasawaMainConjectures L5 does not state.
Added by the review: Theorem D (Bhargava–Skinner) is a rank consequence in ArithmeticStatistics ST.4's direction that no stage states.

notes: Independent review by Claude Code, session cc-39fac3, 23 September 2026, of the extraction by cc-7b31c4 (PR #2171's job). The published article was read in full and every item checked against it. 16 statements and 3 names were corrected (the 'p-relaxed' Selmer group is strict at 𝔭; Lemma 2.2.2 and Corollary 2.6.2 are restated to what is proved; the duality and characteristic-ideal items made exact), 16 items were added (10 planned, 6 missing), items 3 and 9 moved from planned to missing with new source routes, item 21 moved to planned. E1–E4 were confirmed (E3 reclassified as affecting nothing), and 7 further mistakes were recorded, among them a gap in Lemma 2.2.2: its injectivity at p holds only when λ is the only prime of M_f above p, so the proofs of Theorems A and E are incomplete when [M_f:Q] > 1; Theorems A′ and C are unaffected. Every change is listed in research/blueprint/reviews/REV-PAPER-SKINNER-20.md.
